invariants.reason: The repo focus ring is a themed neutral applied through the `focus-ring` utility. shadcn ships `focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring` (and older styles `focus:ring-2`), which re-derives the ring from the accent — and the accent is becoming a user knob, so nothing functional may derive from it.

`--destructive` is a TEXT colour (`semantic.color.text.error`, tuned to read on a dark ground). Used as a solid fill it puts white on #ff6467 for 2.89:1, below the 4.5:1 minimum. A tonal `bg-destructive/10` is fine; a solid fill is not.

deviations.reason: Solid destructive badge must use the dedicated surface role (6.42:1 with white in both themes), not the text colour.
Tonal status variants added on top of upstream's four. Without them, organisms hand-paint status chips at the call site over `variant="secondary"`.
Button carried the same white-on-#ff6467 pair as badge. Same fix, same reason.
Added size not present upstream. ai-elements toolbars need a 32px icon button; without it they set `className="h-8 w-8"` at every call site.

Inline citations render inside

. Upstream's un-portalled content makes h4/p/blockquote descendants of a paragraph, which is invalid HTML and reflows unpredictably.
Upstream's CommandDialog pulls in the dialog primitive for a subcomponent nothing here uses, and pushes the file over the LOC guard.

contracts.reason: Agent is typed against the AI SDK tool definition.
Attachments consume the SDK's file/source message parts rather than a local shape.
Confirmation renders a tool-call part straight off the message stream.
The context meter reads the SDK's usage record; a local shape would silently drift from provider field moves.
Context window sizes come from tokenlens, not a hand-maintained table.
Image renders the SDK's generated-image payload.
Message is typed against the SDK message protocol — the core contract of the whole set.
Streaming markdown rendering is Streamdown's job. Replacing it with a plain markdown renderer loses partial-token handling mid-stream.
Composer attachments are SDK message parts, so what the composer produces is submittable without translation.
Same contract as prompt-input; this file holds the shared context after the LOC split.
Submit/stop button state is driven by the SDK chat status, not a local enum.
Reasoning bodies arrive token by token; Streamdown handles partial markdown.
Upstream's open/duration state machine — controllable open state plus auto-close once streaming ends. Re-implementing it with plain useState loses the controlled-prop path.
Sandbox renders a tool-call part off the message stream.
Tool lifecycle states come from the SDK part union, so new SDK states surface as type errors rather than silently unrendered.
